headword: {体外受精|たいがいじゅせい}

definitions.gloss: in vitro fertilization; IVF; extracorporeal fertilization
definitions.explanation: A medical procedure in which an egg is fertilized by sperm outside the body, and the resulting embryo is transferred to the uterus. A major assisted reproductive technology.

examples.japanese: {体外受精|たいがいじゅせい}で{子|こ}どもを{授|さず}かった。
examples.english: We had a child through IVF.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{体外受精|たいがいじゅせい}に{保険|ほけん}が{適用|てきよう}されるようになった。
examples.english: In Japan, IVF has become covered by health insurance.

examples.japanese: {体外受精|たいがいじゅせい}は{費用|ひよう}も{身体|しんたい}への{負担|ふたん}も{大|おお}きいが、{不妊治療|ふにんちりょう}の{選択肢|せんたくし}として{広|ひろ}まっている。
examples.english: IVF is costly and physically demanding, but it has become widespread as a fertility treatment option.

notes:
Composed of {体外|たいがい} (outside the body) and {受精|じゅせい} (fertilization). Literally "fertilization outside the body." This is a key term in reproductive medicine and has become increasingly common in everyday Japanese as public awareness and insurance coverage for fertility treatments have expanded. In 2022, Japan extended health insurance coverage to include IVF treatments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体外受精|たいがいじゅせい}を{行|おこな}う: to perform IVF
- {体外受精|たいがいじゅせい}の{成功率|せいこうりつ}: IVF success rate
- {体外受精|たいがいじゅせい}による{妊娠|にんしん}: pregnancy through IVF

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人工授精|じんこうじゅせい}: artificial insemination — a simpler procedure where sperm is placed directly in the uterus, without removing the egg
- {不妊治療|ふにんちりょう}: fertility treatment — the broader category of medical treatments for infertility
- {顕微授精|けんびじゅせい}: intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) — a more advanced form where a single sperm is injected directly into the egg
